records.name: Institute of Chemical Technology (ICT) Mumbai
records.description: Institute of Chemical Technology (ICT) Mumbai, formerly UDCT, is a deemed university considered the 'IIT of chemical technology' in India, known for producing leaders in the chemical, petrochemical, and pharmaceutical industries. It offers undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs in chemical engineering, dyestuff technology, polymer engineering, and pharmaceutical sciences. ICT has unparalleled industry connectivity with chemical majors like Reliance, BASF, and Tata Chemicals.

records.name: NALSAR University of Law
records.description: NALSAR University of Law Hyderabad is one of India's premier National Law Universities, consistently ranked among the top three law schools in the country. It offers the five-year integrated B.A. LL.B. program alongside LL.M. and Ph.D. programs, with particular strength in corporate law, IPR, and international law. NALSAR is known for its rigorous legal education, moot court culture, and strong placement record with top law firms and judicial services.

records.name: National Law University Delhi
records.description: National Law University Delhi is regarded as one of India's top-ranked National Law Universities, known for producing graduates who go on to top law firms, the judiciary, and international organizations. It offers the B.A. LL.B. (Hons.) five-year program, LL.M., and Ph.D. degrees with specializations in criminal justice, commercial law, and human rights. NLU Delhi is the organizing institution for AILET, its own national entrance test.

records.name: NUJS Kolkata
records.description: The West Bengal National University of Juridical Sciences (NUJS) Kolkata is one of India's premier National Law Universities, consistently ranked in the top five law schools nationally. It offers the five-year B.A. LL.B. (Hons.) program and LL.M. with strong faculties in commercial law, cyber law, and environmental law. NUJS is known for its vibrant legal aid clinic, moot court program, and placements in leading domestic and international law firms.

records.name: Gujarat National Law University
records.description: Gujarat National Law University (GNLU) Gandhinagar is a highly regarded National Law University offering the five-year integrated B.A. LL.B. program along with LL.M. and Ph.D. degrees. The university is known for its research output in ADR, corporate law, and constitutional law, and hosts several international moot court teams. GNLU has strong placement links with top-tier law firms and offers a structured clinical legal education program.

records.name: Faculty of Law Delhi University
records.description: The Faculty of Law at the University of Delhi is one of India's oldest and most prestigious law schools, tracing its history to 1924. It offers the three-year LL.B. program (post-graduation) along with LL.M. and Ph.D. degrees, and attracts students from across the country. The faculty has produced numerous Supreme Court judges, senior advocates, and public intellectuals.

records.name: ILS Law College Pune
records.description: ILS Law College Pune is one of the oldest and most reputed law colleges in India, established in 1924, and affiliated with Savitribai Phule Pune University. It offers three-year LL.B. and five-year integrated B.A. LL.B. programs with strong emphasis on practical legal training, debates, and moot courts. The college has produced eminent judges, lawyers, and legal academics across India.

records.name: Government Law College Mumbai
records.description: Government Law College Mumbai, established in 1855, is the oldest law school in Asia and one of the most prestigious legal institutions in India. It is affiliated with the University of Mumbai and offers the three-year LL.B. program to working professionals and fresh graduates alike. GLC Mumbai alumni include many of India's most distinguished jurists, politicians, and legal scholars.

records.name: National Academy of Direct Taxes (NADT)
records.description: National Academy of Direct Taxes (NADT) Nagpur is the apex training institution for IRS (IT) officers under the Central Board of Direct Taxes, Ministry of Finance. It conducts foundational and in-service training programs for officers in income tax administration, international taxation, and transfer pricing. NADT also serves as a research hub for tax policy and capacity building in direct tax administration.

records.name: National Academy of Customs Indirect Taxes and Narcotics (NACIN)
records.description: National Academy of Customs Indirect Taxes and Narcotics (NACIN) is the premier training institution for IRS (Customs & Indirect Taxes) officers, located in Faridabad with regional campuses across India. It provides foundational training for officers joining the Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC) and in-service programs on GST, customs valuation, and anti-smuggling. NACIN also conducts training programs for officers from friendly foreign countries in excise and customs administration.
